title: Lilly Completes Acquisition of Prevail Therapeutics
主要内容: Eli Lilly and Company completed its acquisition of Prevail Therapeutics Inc. on January 22, 2021, through the merger of Tyto Acquisition Corporation with and into Prevail, without a shareholder vote. The transaction involved a tender offer at $22.50 per share, plus one non-tradable contingent value right (CVR), representing up to $4.00 per share. The offer expired on January 21, 2021, with no changes to Lilly's 2021 financial guidance. The acquisition aims to expand Lilly's research efforts in gene therapy, leveraging Prevail's neuroscience assets. Mark Mintun, M.D., stated the deal could deliver transformative treatments for patients with neurodegenerative diseases such as Parkinson's, Gaucher, and dementia. The transaction's impact will be reflected in Lilly's 2021 financial results under GAAP. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Eli Lilly and Company (LLY), Prevail Therapeutics Inc. (PRVL).
